title: Terminal
wrap_on: Wrap long lines: on (fold at the panel's width)
wrap_off: Wrap long lines: off (scroll sideways at the computer's width)
busy_title: Another program on the computer is using this terminal
busy_detail: Another herdr client, for example. Taking control disconnects it and sizes the terminal to this panel. When you close the panel, the pane goes back to the computer's size.
paste_detail: A shell may run multi-line text one line at a time.
history_limit: — herdr keeps only the last ~1000 lines. Earlier output is in the chat —
load_older: Scroll up to load earlier output
size_poll_hint: This computer can't stream the terminal, so the screen is read once a second
size_watch_hint: You can only watch here, not type
mode_control_hint: The pane on the computer takes this panel's size, and what you type here goes into the terminal
mode_watch_hint: The pane on the computer stays as it is; you can't type here
grid_pane: The pane on the computer is {cols} columns × {rows} rows
stopped: This Agent has stopped. Resume runs it again in this terminal.
stopped_closed: This Agent has stopped and its terminal was closed. Resume runs it again in a new tab.
